mapper.sql: ti_id, tt_id, kind, seq, item_nm, required_yn, form_doc_no
mapper.select: select from pms_template_item where tmpl_id = #{tmplId} order by tt_id, kind, seq
select from pms_template_item where ti_id = #{id}
select tmpl_id from pms_template_item where ti_id = #{id}

insert into pms_template_item (comp_cd, tmpl_id, tt_id, kind, seq, item_nm, required_yn, form_doc_no, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{tmplId}, #{ttId}, #{kind}, (select coalesce(max(seq), 0) + 10 from pms_template_item where tt_id = #{ttId} and kind = #{kind}), #{itemNm}, #{requiredYn}, #{formDocNo}, #{by}) returning ti_id
mapper.insert: insert into pms_task_check (comp_cd, proj_id, task_id, seq, check_nm, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{taskId}, #{seq}, #{checkNm}, #{by})
mapper.select: select check_nm from pms_task_check where task_id = #{taskId} order by seq
mapper.sql: d.deliv_id, d.proj_id, d.task_id, d.seq, d.deliv_nm, d.required_yn, d.form_doc_no, d.owner_user_id, u.login_id as owner_login_id, u.user_nm as owner_nm, d.due_date, d.status, d.ref_type, d.ref_id, f.orig_name as file_name, d.waive_reason, d.decision_note, d.decided_by, d.decided_at, d.submitted_by, d.submitted_at, d.sub_cnt, d.row_ver, t.task_nm, t.task_type, t.owner_user_id as task_owner_user_id, t.plan_end as task_plan_end, coalesce(d.due_date, t.plan_end) as due
from pms_deliverable d join pms_task t on t.task_id = d.task_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.owner_user_id left join sys_file f on d.ref_type = 'FILE' and f.file_id = d.ref_id
mapper.select: select where d.deliv_id = #{id}
select proj_id from pms_deliverable where deliv_id = #{id}
select p.status from pms_deliverable d join pms_project p on p.proj_id = d.proj_id where d.deliv_id = #{id} and d.ref_type is distinct from 'QMS_DOC_REV'
mapper.update: update sys_file set locked_yn = 'Y', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where file_id = #{fileId} and target_type = 'pms-deliverable' and locked_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: insert into pms_deliverable (comp_cd, proj_id, task_id, seq, deliv_nm, required_yn, form_doc_no, owner_user_id, due_date, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{taskId}, (select coalesce(max(seq), 0) + 10 from pms_deliverable where task_id = #{taskId}), #{delivNm}, #{requiredYn}, #{formDocNo}, #{ownerUserId}, #{dueDate}, #{by}, #{by}) returning deliv_id
mapper.update: update pms_deliverable set status = 'APPROVED', decision_note = #{note}, decided_by = #{by}, decided_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where deliv_id = #{id} and status = 'SUBMITTED' and ref_type in ('QMS_DOC_REV', 'PLM_PPAP', 'APQP_FMEA', 'APQP_CP')
mapper.select: select count(*) from pms_deliverable where proj_id = #{projId} and ref_type = 'PLM_PPAP'
select eco_id from pms_project where proj_id = #{projId}
select where d.proj_id = #{projId} and d.ref_type in ('QMS_DOC_REV', 'PLM_PPAP', 'APQP_FMEA', 'APQP_CP') and d.status = 'SUBMITTED' order by d.deliv_id
mapper.update: update pms_deliverable set status = #{status}, waive_reason = case when #{status} = 'WAIVED' then #{note} else null end, decision_note = case when #{status} in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') then #{note} else null end, decided_by = case when #{status} = 'NONE' then null else #{by} end, decided_at = case when #{status} = 'NONE' then null else now() end, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where deliv_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select count(*) from pms_deliverable_hist where deliv_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into pms_deliverable_hist (comp_cd, proj_id, deliv_id, action, file_id, note, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{delivId}, #{action}, #{fileId}, #{note}, #{by})

insert into pms_deliverable_hist (comp_cd, proj_id, deliv_id, action, doc_rev_id, ppap_id, fmea_id, cp_id, note, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{delivId}, 'LINK', #{docRevId}, #{ppapId}, #{fmeaId}, #{cpId}, #{note}, #{by})
mapper.select: select h.dh_id, h.action, h.file_id, f.orig_name as file_name, h.doc_rev_id, h.ppap_id, h.fmea_id, h.cp_id, h.note, h.created_at, h.created_by from pms_deliverable_hist h left join sys_file f on f.file_id = h.file_id where h.deliv_id = #{delivId} order by h.dh_id desc
select count(*) from pms_gate_review where gate_task_id = #{taskId}
select count(*) from pms_issue where task_id = #{taskId}
select count(*) from pms_deliverable where proj_id = #{projId} and required_yn = 'Y' and status not in ('APPROVED', 'WAIVED')
select count(*) from pms_issue where proj_id = #{projId} and status <> 'CLOSED'
mapper.sql: r.review_id, r.proj_id, r.gate_task_id, r.review_no, r.review_date, r.decision, r.status, r.summary, r.req_cnt, r.ready_cnt, r.apr_id, a.status as apr_status, a.requester_id as apr_requester_id, r.decided_at, r.decided_by, r.row_ver, r.created_at, r.created_by
mapper.select: select from pms_gate_review r left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = r.apr_id where r.proj_id = #{projId} order by r.gate_task_id, r.review_no desc
select status from pms_gate_review where review_id = #{id} for update
select coalesce(max(review_no), 0) + 1 from pms_gate_review where gate_task_id = #{gateTaskId}

insert into pms_gate_review (comp_cd, proj_id, gate_task_id, review_no, review_date, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{gateTaskId}, #{no}, #{reviewDate}, #{by}, #{by}) returning review_id
mapper.update: update pms_gate_review set review_date = #{reviewDate}, decision = #{decision}, summary = #{summary}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where review_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'

update pms_gate_review set status = 'IN_APPROVAL', req_cnt = #{reqCnt}, ready_cnt = #{readyCnt}, apr_id = null, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where review_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update pms_gate_review set apr_id = #{aprId} where review_id = #{id}

update pms_gate_review set status = 'DECIDED', req_cnt = #{reqCnt}, ready_cnt = #{readyCnt}, decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where review_id = #{id} and status in ('DRAFT', 'IN_APPROVAL')
mapper.select: select gc_id, seq, check_nm, result, note from pms_gate_check where review_id = #{reviewId} order by seq
mapper.insert: insert into pms_gate_check (comp_cd, review_id, seq, check_nm, result, note) values (hb_current_comp(), #{reviewId}, #{seq}, #{checkNm}, #{result}, #{note})
mapper.select: select c.cond_id, c.seq, c.title, c.owner_user_id, u.login_id as owner_login_id, u.user_nm as owner_nm, c.due_date, c.issue_id, i.issue_no from pms_gate_cond c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.owner_user_id left join pms_issue i on i.issue_id = c.issue_id where c.review_id = #{reviewId} order by c.seq
mapper.insert: insert into pms_gate_cond (comp_cd, review_id, seq, title, owner_user_id, due_date) values (hb_current_comp(), #{reviewId}, #{seq}, #{title}, #{ownerUserId}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: update pms_gate_cond set issue_id = #{issueId} where cond_id = #{condId} and issue_id is null
mapper.select: select l.seq, l.approver_id, u.user_nm as approver_nm, l.line_type, l.status, l.acted_at, l.comment from apr_line l join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.approver_id where l.apr_id = #{aprId} order by l.seq

insert into pms_issue (comp_cd, issue_no, proj_id, task_id, title, severity, owner_user_id, due_date, source, gate_review_id, issue_type, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{issueNo}, #{projId}, #{taskId}, #{title}, 'MID', #{ownerUserId}, #{dueDate}, 'GATE', #{reviewId}, 'RISK', #{by}, #{by}) returning issue_id
